"""Bounded, opt-in HTTPS capture and a separate resumable request cache."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import http.client
import ipaddress
import json
import socket
import ssl
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Protocol
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urljoin, urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from ashare_quant.backtest.continuous_source import file_hash, payload_hash, read_json
from ashare_quant.data.economic_event_sources import safe_file
from ashare_quant.utils.manifest import atomic_write_json

HOSTS = frozenset({"www.cninfo.com.cn", "static.cninfo.com.cn"})
REDIRECTS = {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}


class AnnouncementError(ValueError):
    """Stable acquisition error code; never include remote credentials or bodies."""


def check(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AnnouncementError(code)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def official_url(url: str) -> str:
    try:
        p = urlsplit(url)
        valid = (
            p.scheme == "https"
            and p.hostname in HOSTS
            and p.port in (None, 443)
            and not p.username
            and not p.password
            and not p.fragment
            and "\\" not in url
            and not any(ord(c) < 33 for c in url)
        )
    except ValueError:
        valid = False
    check(valid, "ANNOUNCEMENT_UNSAFE_URL")
    return url


class Limits(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    connect_timeout: float = Field(default=10, gt=0, le=60)
    read_timeout: float = Field(default=30, gt=0, le=120)
    retries: int = Field(default=2, ge=0, le=3)
    interval: float = Field(default=1, ge=0.1, le=60)
    backoff: float = Field(default=1, ge=0, le=10)
    max_redirects: int = Field(default=3, ge=0, le=5)
    max_requests: int = Field(default=200, ge=1, le=1000)
    response_bytes: int = Field(default=4_000_000, ge=128, le=20_000_000)
    pdf_bytes: int = Field(default=50_000_000, ge=128, le=100_000_000)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reply:
    status: int
    headers: dict[str, str]
    body: bytes


class Transport(Protocol):
    def exchange(
        self, method: str, url: str, form: dict[str, str], limit: int, policy: Limits
    ) -> Reply: ...


class PublicHTTPSConnection(http.client.HTTPSConnection):
    """Resolve once and connect to a checked public IP; TLS still verifies hostname."""

    def connect(self) -> None:
        addresses = socket.getaddrinfo(self.host, 443, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        check(bool(addresses), "ANNOUNCEMENT_DNS_EMPTY")
        check(
            all(ipaddress.ip_address(a[4][0]).is_global for a in addresses),
            "ANNOUNCEMENT_NON_PUBLIC_ADDRESS",
        )
        family, socktype, proto, _, address = addresses[0]
        sock = socket.socket(family, socktype, proto)
        try:
            sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
            sock.connect(address)
            self.sock = ssl.create_default_context().wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=self.host)
        except BaseException:
            sock.close()
            raise


class HTTPSWire:
    def __init__(self, *, authorized: bool = False) -> None:
        self.authorized = authorized

    def exchange(
        self, method: str, url: str, form: dict[str, str], limit: int, policy: Limits
    ) -> Reply:
        check(self.authorized, "ANNOUNCEMENT_NETWORK_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
        p = urlsplit(official_url(url))
        connection = PublicHTTPSConnection(str(p.hostname), timeout=policy.connect_timeout)
        try:
            connection.connect()
            assert connection.sock is not None
            connection.sock.settimeout(policy.read_timeout)
            target = p.path or "/"
            if p.query:
                target += "?" + p.query
            connection.request(
                method,
                target,
                body=urlencode(form).encode() if method == "POST" else None,
                headers={
                    "User-Agent": "ashare-quant-announcement/1",
                    "Accept": "application/json, application/pdf",
                    "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
                    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8",
                },
            )
            response = connection.getresponse()
            headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in response.getheaders()}
            check(headers.get("content-encoding", "identity") == "identity", "ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED")
            if "content-length" in headers:
                check(0 <= int(headers["content-length"]) <= limit, "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
            data = bytearray()
            deadline = time.monotonic() + policy.read_timeout
            while True:
                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise TimeoutError
                if connection.sock is not None:
                    connection.sock.settimeout(remaining)
                chunk = response.read1(min(65536, limit + 1 - len(data)))
                if not chunk:
                    break
                data.extend(chunk)
                check(len(data) <= limit, "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
            if "content-length" in headers:
                check(len(data) == int(headers["content-length"]), "RESPONSE_TRUNCATED")
            return Reply(response.status, headers, bytes(data))
        finally:
            connection.close()


def request_spec(url: str, form: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "url": official_url(url),
        "method": "POST" if form is not None else "GET",
        "form": form or {},
    }


def outcome(attempt: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if attempt["error"]:
        return str(attempt["error"])
    code = attempt["http_status"]
    if code == 200:
        return "CAPTURED"
    if code in (401, 403):
        return "PERMISSION_REQUIRED"
    if code == 429:
        return "RATE_LIMITED"
    if code >= 500:
        return "SERVER_REJECTED"
    return "HTTP_ERROR"


def validate_capture(capture: dict[str, Any], blobs: dict[str, bytes], policy: Limits) -> None:
    spec = capture["request"]
    check(
        spec == request_spec(spec["url"], spec["form"] if spec["method"] == "POST" else None),
        "REQUEST_SCHEMA",
    )
    check(capture["request_id"] == payload_hash(spec), "REQUEST_ID")
    attempts = capture["attempts"]
    check(0 < len(attempts) <= (policy.retries + 1) * (policy.max_redirects + 1), "ATTEMPT_LIMIT")
    expected_url = spec["url"]
    retries, redirects = 0, 0
    for i, attempt in enumerate(attempts):
        check(attempt["url"] == expected_url, "REDIRECT_CHAIN")
        official_url(attempt["url"])
        check(
            attempt["error"]
            in (
                None,
                "TIMEOUT",
                "NETWORK_ERROR",
                "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE",
                "RESPONSE_TRUNCATED",
                "ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED",
                "ANNOUNCEMENT_NON_PUBLIC_ADDRESS",
                "ANNOUNCEMENT_DNS_EMPTY",
                "REQUEST_LIMIT",
                "ANNOUNCEMENT_UNSAFE_URL",
            ),
            "CAPTURE_ERROR",
        )
        if attempt["body_sha256"] is not None:
            check(
                type(attempt["http_status"]) is int
                and 100 <= attempt["http_status"] <= 599
                and attempt["error"] is None,
                "HTTP_STATUS_SCHEMA",
            )
            body = blobs[attempt["body_sha256"]]
            check(
                digest(body) == attempt["body_sha256"] and len(body) == attempt["size"],
                "RESPONSE_HASH",
            )
            cap = policy.pdf_bytes if spec["method"] == "GET" else policy.response_bytes
            check(len(body) <= cap, "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
        else:
            check(
                attempt["error"] is not None and attempt["http_status"] is None, "MISSING_RESPONSE"
            )
        if i + 1 < len(attempts):
            if attempt["http_status"] in REDIRECTS:
                redirects += 1
                check(redirects <= policy.max_redirects, "REDIRECT_LIMIT")
                check(
                    spec["method"] == "GET" or attempt["http_status"] in (307, 308),
                    "POST_REDIRECT_REWRITE",
                )
                expected_url = official_url(urljoin(attempt["url"], attempt["location"]))
            else:
                retries += 1
                redirects = 0
                check(retries <= policy.retries, "RETRY_LIMIT")
                check(
                    attempt["error"] in ("TIMEOUT", "NETWORK_ERROR")
                    or attempt["http_status"] in (500, 502, 504),
                    "RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED",
                )
                expected_url = spec["url"]
    check(
        capture["status"] in (outcome(attempts[-1]), "IN_PROGRESS", "REDIRECT_REJECTED"),
        "CAPTURE_STATUS",
    )
    if capture["status"] == "REDIRECT_REJECTED":
        check(attempts[-1]["http_status"] in REDIRECTS, "REDIRECT_STATUS")


class CaptureCache:
    """Hash-checked request journal. Explicit retry preserves every earlier capture."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path, policy: Limits) -> None:
        self.root, self.policy = root, policy

    def register_worklist(self, body: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        path = self.root / "worklists" / (payload_hash(body) + ".json")
        if path.exists():
            check(read_json(path) == body, "CACHE_WORKLIST_CORRUPT")
        else:
            atomic_write_json(path, body)

    def save(self, capture: dict[str, Any], blobs: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for h, data in blobs.items():
            check(digest(data) == h, "CACHE_BODY_HASH")
            path = self.root / "blobs" / (h + ".bin")
            path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            if path.exists():
                check(file_hash(path) == h, "CACHE_CORRUPT")
            else:
                with path.open("xb") as output:
                    output.write(data)
        h = payload_hash(capture)
        target = self.root / "captures" / (h + ".json")
        if not target.exists():
            atomic_write_json(target, capture)
        pointer = self.root / "requests" / (capture["request_id"] + ".json")
        history = read_json(pointer)["history"] if pointer.exists() else []
        if h not in history:
            atomic_write_json(pointer, {"history": [*history, h]})

    def load(self, spec: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, bytes]] | None:
        pointer = self.root / "requests" / (payload_hash(spec) + ".json")
        if not pointer.exists():
            return None
        history = read_json(pointer)["history"]
        check(bool(history), "CACHE_CORRUPT")
        latest: tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, bytes]] | None = None
        for h in history:
            capture = read_json(safe_file(self.root, f"captures/{h}.json"))
            check(payload_hash(capture) == h and capture["request"] == spec, "CACHE_CORRUPT")
            blobs = {
                a["body_sha256"]: safe_file(self.root, f"blobs/{a['body_sha256']}.bin").read_bytes()
                for a in capture["attempts"]
                if a["body_sha256"] is not None
            }
            validate_capture(capture, blobs, self.policy)
            latest = capture, blobs
        return latest


class SafeHTTPClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        authorized: bool = False,
        policy: Limits | None = None,
        transport: Transport | None = None,
        cache: CaptureCache | None = None,
        retry_failed: bool = False,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
    ) -> None:
        self.authorized = authorized
        self.policy = policy or Limits()
        self.transport = transport or HTTPSWire(authorized=authorized)
        self.cache, self.retry_failed, self.sleep = cache, retry_failed, sleep
        self.requests = 0

    def fetch(self, spec: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, bytes]]:
        official_url(spec["url"])
        cached = self.cache.load(spec) if self.cache else None
        if cached and (cached[0]["status"] == "CAPTURED" or not self.retry_failed):
            return cached
        check(self.authorized, "ANNOUNCEMENT_NETWORK_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
        attempts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        blobs: dict[str, bytes] = {}
        capture = {
            "request": spec,
            "request_id": payload_hash(spec),
            "attempts": attempts,
            "status": "IN_PROGRESS",
        }
        for retry in range(self.policy.retries + 1):
            url = spec["url"]
            for hop in range(self.policy.max_redirects + 1):
                a: dict[str, Any] = {
                    "url": url,
                    "http_status": None,
                    "body_sha256": None,
                    "size": 0,
                    "location": None,
                    "error": None,
                }
                try:
                    check(self.requests < self.policy.max_requests, "REQUEST_LIMIT")
                    self.sleep(
                        self.policy.interval
                        + (self.policy.backoff * 2 ** (retry - 1) if retry else 0)
                    )
                    self.requests += 1
                    cap = (
                        self.policy.pdf_bytes
                        if spec["method"] == "GET"
                        else self.policy.response_bytes
                    )
                    reply = self.transport.exchange(
                        spec["method"], url, spec["form"], cap, self.policy
                    )
                    check(len(reply.body) <= cap, "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
                    h = digest(reply.body)
                    blobs[h] = reply.body
                    a.update(
                        http_status=reply.status,
                        body_sha256=h,
                        size=len(reply.body),
                        location=reply.headers.get("location"),
                    )
                except TimeoutError:
                    a["error"] = "TIMEOUT"
                except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
                    a["error"] = "NETWORK_ERROR"
                except AnnouncementError as error:
                    a["error"] = str(error)
                attempts.append(a)
                if self.cache:
                    capture["status"] = "IN_PROGRESS"
                    self.cache.save(capture, blobs)
                if a["http_status"] in REDIRECTS:
                    try:
                        check(
                            hop < self.policy.max_redirects and bool(a["location"]),
                            "ANNOUNCEMENT_UNSAFE_URL",
                        )
                        # POST redirection semantics must not silently discard/rewrite a query.
                        check(
                            spec["method"] == "GET" or a["http_status"] in (307, 308),
                            "ANNOUNCEMENT_UNSAFE_URL",
                        )
                        url = official_url(urljoin(url, a["location"]))
                        continue
                    except AnnouncementError:
                        capture["status"] = "REDIRECT_REJECTED"
                        break
                capture["status"] = outcome(a)
                break
            retryable = attempts[-1]["error"] in ("TIMEOUT", "NETWORK_ERROR") or attempts[-1][
                "http_status"
            ] in (500, 502, 504)
            if not retryable:
                break
        validate_capture(capture, blobs, self.policy)
        if self.cache:
            self.cache.save(capture, blobs)
        return capture, blobs


def _unique_object(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
    check(len({key for key, _ in pairs}) == len(pairs), "JSON_DUPLICATE_KEY")
    return dict(pairs)


def _invalid_constant(value: str) -> None:
    raise AnnouncementError("JSON_NON_FINITE")


def response_json(capture: dict[str, Any], blobs: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, Any] | list[Any]:
    check(capture["status"] == "CAPTURED", "RESPONSE_NOT_CAPTURED")
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(
            blobs[capture["attempts"][-1]["body_sha256"]],
            object_pairs_hook=_unique_object,
            parse_constant=_invalid_constant,
        )
        check(isinstance(parsed, (dict, list)), "JSON_ROOT_SCHEMA")
        assert isinstance(parsed, (dict, list))
        return parsed
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise AnnouncementError("RESPONSE_NOT_JSON_OR_ACCESS_CHALLENGE") from error

"""Single-security CNINFO discovery, replayable entirely from frozen HTTP bytes."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from typing import Any, Protocol
from urllib.parse import urljoin

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from ashare_quant.backtest.continuous_source import payload_hash
from ashare_quant.data.announcement_http import (
    AnnouncementError,
    SafeHTTPClient,
    check,
    official_url,
    request_spec,
    response_json,
)

TOP_SEARCH = "https://www.cninfo.com.cn/new/information/topSearch/query"
QUERY_URL = "https://www.cninfo.com.cn/new/hisAnnouncement/query"
STATIC_URL = "https://static.cninfo.com.cn/"
PROVIDER = "CNINFO_PUBLIC_WEB"
PLATES = {"SH": "sh", "SZ": "sz", "BJ": "bj"}
EXCHANGES = {
    "sh": "SH",
    "sse": "SH",
    "SH": "SH",
    "sz": "SZ",
    "szse": "SZ",
    "SZ": "SZ",
    "bj": "BJ",
    "bse": "BJ",
    "BJ": "BJ",
}
CATALOG_COLUMNS = [
    "provider",
    "provider_request_id",
    "source_sec_code",
    "canonical_ts_code",
    "exchange",
    "plate",
    "org_id",
    "org_id_response_hash",
    "announcement_id",
    "announcement_date",
    "announcement_timestamp",
    "announcement_title",
    "announcement_type",
    "adjunct_url",
    "official_document_url",
    "raw_response_hash",
    "raw_row_hash",
    "keyword_match",
    "source_format",
    "document_sha256",
    "document_size",
    "fetch_status",
    "extraction_status",
]


class AnnouncementQuery(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    ts_code: str = Field(pattern=r"^[0-9]{6}\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$")
    start_date: str = Field(pattern=r"^[0-9]{8}$")
    end_date: str = Field(pattern=r"^[0-9]{8}$")
    keyword: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    category: str = Field(default="", pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_;]*$", max_length=120)
    page_size: int = Field(default=30, ge=1, le=30)
    max_pages: int = Field(default=100, ge=1, le=100)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def dates(self) -> AnnouncementQuery:
        for dt in (self.start_date, self.end_date):
            datetime.strptime(dt, "%Y%m%d")
        check(self.start_date <= self.end_date, "QUERY_DATE_ORDER")
        return self


@dataclass
class SearchProgress:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]]
    status: str
    issues: list[str]
    next_request: dict[str, Any] | None


@dataclass
class SearchResult:
    query: AnnouncementQuery
    captures: list[dict[str, Any]]
    blobs: dict[str, bytes]
    progress: SearchProgress


class AnnouncementProvider(Protocol):
    def search(self, query: AnnouncementQuery) -> SearchResult: ...


class _Title(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts: list[str] = []

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        self.parts.append(data)


def title_text(text: str) -> str:
    parser = _Title()
    parser.feed(text)
    return "".join(parser.parts).strip()


def org_identity(query: AnnouncementQuery, response: dict[str, Any] | list[Any]) -> str:
    rows = response.get("stockList") if isinstance(response, dict) else response
    check(isinstance(rows, list), "ORG_RESPONSE_SCHEMA")
    assert isinstance(rows, list)
    matches: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for row in rows:
        check(isinstance(row, dict), "ORG_RESPONSE_SCHEMA")
        codes = {str(row[k]) for k in ("code", "secCode", "stockCode") if row.get(k)}
        if query.ts_code[:6] not in codes:
            continue
        check(codes == {query.ts_code[:6]}, "ORG_CODE_CONFLICT")
        exchanges = {
            EXCHANGES[str(row[k])] for k in ("plate", "exchange") if str(row.get(k)) in EXCHANGES
        }
        if not exchanges and row.get("column") == "sse":
            exchanges = {"SH"}
        check(len(exchanges) == 1, "ORG_EXCHANGE_UNVERIFIED")
        if row.get("column") is not None:
            expected_column = "sse" if exchanges == {"SH"} else "szse"
            check(row["column"] == expected_column, "ORG_COLUMN_CONFLICT")
        check(isinstance(row.get("orgId"), str) and bool(row["orgId"].strip()), "ORG_ID_MISSING")
        matches.add((row["orgId"], next(iter(exchanges))))
    check(len(matches) == 1, "ORG_NOT_FOUND_OR_AMBIGUOUS")
    org, exchange = next(iter(matches))
    check(exchange == query.ts_code[-2:], "ORG_EXCHANGE_MISMATCH")
    return org


def page_request(query: AnnouncementQuery, org: str, page: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    def fmt(dt: str) -> str:
        return datetime.strptime(dt, "%Y%m%d").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    return request_spec(
        QUERY_URL,
        {
            "stock": f"{query.ts_code[:6]},{org}",
            "tabName": "fulltext",
            "pageSize": str(query.page_size),
            "pageNum": str(page),
            "column": "sse" if query.ts_code.endswith(".SH") else "szse",
            "plate": PLATES[query.ts_code[-2:]],
            "searchkey": query.keyword,
            "category": query.category,
            "seDate": f"{fmt(query.start_date)}~{fmt(query.end_date)}",
            "isHLtitle": "false",
        },
    )


def announcement_record(
    row: dict[str, Any],
    query: AnnouncementQuery,
    org: str,
    capture: dict[str, Any],
    org_hash: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    check(
        row.get("secCode") == query.ts_code[:6] and row.get("orgId") == org,
        "ANNOUNCEMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH",
    )
    for field in ("announcementId", "announcementTitle", "adjunctUrl", "adjunctType"):
        check(
            isinstance(row.get(field), str) and bool(row[field].strip()), "ANNOUNCEMENT_ROW_SCHEMA"
        )
    check(isinstance(row.get("announcementType"), (str, type(None))), "ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPE_SCHEMA")
    timestamp = row.get("announcementTime")
    check(type(timestamp) is int and 0 <= timestamp < 32_503_680_000_000, "ANNOUNCEMENT_TIMESTAMP")
    assert isinstance(timestamp, int)
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp / 1000, tz=timezone(timedelta(hours=8)))
    date = dt.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    check(query.start_date <= date <= query.end_date, "ANNOUNCEMENT_OUT_OF_WINDOW")
    url = official_url(urljoin(STATIC_URL, row["adjunctUrl"]))
    check(url.startswith(STATIC_URL), "ANNOUNCEMENT_DOCUMENT_HOST")
    title = title_text(row["announcementTitle"])
    return {
        "provider": PROVIDER,
        "provider_request_id": capture["request_id"],
        "source_sec_code": row["secCode"],
        "canonical_ts_code": query.ts_code,
        "exchange": query.ts_code[-2:],
        "plate": PLATES[query.ts_code[-2:]],
        "org_id": org,
        "org_id_response_hash": org_hash,
        "announcement_id": row["announcementId"],
        "announcement_date": date,
        "announcement_timestamp": dt.isoformat(),
        "announcement_title": title,
        "announcement_type": row.get("announcementType"),
        "adjunct_url": row["adjunctUrl"],
        "official_document_url": url,
        "raw_response_hash": capture["attempts"][-1]["body_sha256"],
        "raw_row_hash": payload_hash(row),
        "keyword_match": "NOT_REQUESTED"
        if not query.keyword
        else "TITLE_LITERAL"
        if query.keyword in title
        else "UNVERIFIED_PROVIDER_MATCH",
        "source_format": row["adjunctType"].upper(),
        "document_sha256": None,
        "document_size": None,
        "fetch_status": "NOT_ATTEMPTED",
        "extraction_status": "NOT_ATTEMPTED",
    }


def analyze_search(
    query: AnnouncementQuery, captures: list[dict[str, Any]], blobs: dict[str, bytes]
) -> SearchProgress:
    """One shared state machine for acquisition and independent business reconstruction."""
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    initial = request_spec(TOP_SEARCH, {"keyWord": query.ts_code[:6], "maxNum": "10"})
    if not captures:
        return SearchProgress(records, "NOT_ATTEMPTED", [], initial)
    check(captures[0]["request"] == initial, "ORG_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
    failure = captures[0]["status"]
    if failure != "CAPTURED":
        check(len(captures) == 1, "EXTRA_SEARCH_CAPTURE")
        return SearchProgress(
            records,
            "PERMISSION_REQUIRED" if failure == "PERMISSION_REQUIRED" else "FAILED",
            [failure],
            None,
        )
    try:
        org = org_identity(query, response_json(captures[0], blobs))
    except AnnouncementError as error:
        check(len(captures) == 1, "EXTRA_SEARCH_CAPTURE")
        return SearchProgress(records, "FAILED", [str(error)], None)
    org_hash = captures[0]["attempts"][-1]["body_sha256"]
    total: int | None = None
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for page, capture in enumerate(captures[1:], 1):
        check(
            page <= query.max_pages and capture["request"] == page_request(query, org, page),
            "PAGE_REQUEST_MISMATCH",
        )
        issues: list[str] = []
        status = "PARTIAL"
        if capture["status"] != "CAPTURED":
            issues = [capture["status"]]
            if capture["status"] == "PERMISSION_REQUIRED":
                status = "PERMISSION_REQUIRED"
        else:
            try:
                body = response_json(capture, blobs)
                check(isinstance(body, dict), "PAGE_SCHEMA")
                assert isinstance(body, dict)
                count, pages, more = (
                    body.get("totalAnnouncement"),
                    body.get("totalpages"),
                    body.get("hasMore"),
                )
                check(
                    type(count) is int
                    and count >= 0
                    and type(pages) is int
                    and pages >= 0
                    and type(more) is bool,
                    "PAGE_COUNTER_SCHEMA",
                )
                assert isinstance(count, int) and isinstance(pages, int)
                check(
                    pages == (count + query.page_size - 1) // query.page_size,
                    "PAGE_TOTAL_INCONSISTENT",
                )
                check(total is None or total == count, "PAGINATION_TOTAL_CHANGED")
                total = count
                items = body.get("announcements")
                if count == 0 and items is None:
                    items = []
                check(isinstance(items, list) and len(items) <= query.page_size, "PAGE_ROWS_SCHEMA")
                assert isinstance(items, list)
                expected = min(query.page_size, max(0, count - (page - 1) * query.page_size))
                check(
                    len(items) == expected and more == (page < pages), "PAGE_COVERAGE_INCONSISTENT"
                )
                page_rows = []
                for raw in items:
                    check(isinstance(raw, dict), "ANNOUNCEMENT_ROW_SCHEMA")
                    record = announcement_record(raw, query, org, capture, org_hash)
                    check(record["announcement_id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ID")
                    seen.add(record["announcement_id"])
                    page_rows.append(record)
                records.extend(page_rows)
                if not more:
                    check(len(records) == count, "ANNOUNCEMENT_TOTAL_MISMATCH")
                    check(len(captures) == page + 1, "EXTRA_SEARCH_CAPTURE")
                    return SearchProgress(records, "COMPLETE", [], None)
            except AnnouncementError as error:
                issues = [str(error)]
        if issues:
            check(len(captures) == page + 1, "EXTRA_SEARCH_CAPTURE")
            return SearchProgress(records, status, issues, None)
    page = len(captures)
    if page > query.max_pages:
        return SearchProgress(records, "PARTIAL", ["MAX_PAGES_REACHED"], None)
    return SearchProgress(
        records, "PARTIAL", ["PAGINATION_INTERRUPTED"], page_request(query, org, page)
    )


class CNINFOAnnouncementProvider:
    def __init__(self, client: SafeHTTPClient) -> None:
        self.client = client

    def search(self, query: AnnouncementQuery) -> SearchResult:
        captures: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        blobs: dict[str, bytes] = {}
        while True:
            progress = analyze_search(query, captures, blobs)
            if progress.next_request is None:
                return SearchResult(query, captures, blobs, progress)
            capture, body = self.client.fetch(progress.next_request)
            captures.append(capture)
            blobs.update(body)

"""Native PDF inspection with bounded local processes; no network or OCR."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import selectors
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from ashare_quant.backtest.continuous_source import file_hash
from ashare_quant.data.announcement_http import AnnouncementError, check

PDF_PAGES_MAX = 1000
PAGE_TEXT_BYTES_MAX = 2_000_000
PARSER_TIMEOUT = 30.0


def tool_path(name: str) -> str:
    check(name in {"pdfinfo", "pdftotext"}, "PARSER_TOOL_UNSUPPORTED")
    path = shutil.which(name)
    check(path is not None, "ANNOUNCEMENT_POPPLER_REQUIRED")
    return str(path)


def run_native(
    args: list[str], *, limit: int, timeout: float = PARSER_TIMEOUT, version: bool = False
) -> bytes:
    """Bound wall time and captured output before materializing it in memory."""
    with subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE) as process:  # noqa: S603
        assert process.stdout is not None and process.stderr is not None
        result = bytearray()
        errors = bytearray()
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        try:
            with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector:
                selector.register(process.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ, result)
                selector.register(process.stderr, selectors.EVENT_READ, errors)
                while selector.get_map():
                    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                    check(remaining > 0, "PARSER_TIMEOUT")
                    ready = selector.select(min(remaining, 0.2))
                    if not ready:
                        continue
                    for key, _ in ready:
                        chunk = os.read(key.fd, min(65536, limit + 1 - len(result) - len(errors)))
                        if not chunk:
                            selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
                            continue
                        key.data.extend(chunk)
                        check(len(result) + len(errors) <= limit, "PARSER_OUTPUT_LIMIT")
            check(
                process.wait(timeout=max(0.01, deadline - time.monotonic())) == 0, "PARSER_FAILED"
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
            raise AnnouncementError("PARSER_TIMEOUT") from error
        except BaseException:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
            raise
    check(version or not errors, "PARSER_STDERR")
    return bytes(result + errors if version else result)


def tool_identity(name: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    path = tool_path(name)
    version = (
        run_native([path, "-v"], limit=16384, version=True)
        .decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        .splitlines()[0]
    )
    return {"name": name, "version": version, "binary_sha256": file_hash(Path(path))}


def inspect_pdf(data: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not data.startswith(b"%PDF-") or b"%%EOF" not in data[-4096:]:
        return {"status": "INVALID_PDF", "total_pages": None}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="announcement-pdf-") as temporary:
        path = Path(temporary) / "document.pdf"
        path.write_bytes(data)
        try:
            text = run_native([tool_path("pdfinfo"), str(path)], limit=65536).decode(
                "utf-8", errors="strict"
            )
            pages = re.search(r"^Pages:\s+(\d+)\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
            check(pages is not None, "PDF_PAGE_COUNT_MISSING")
            assert pages is not None
            count = int(pages[1])
            check(0 < count <= PDF_PAGES_MAX, "PDF_PAGE_LIMIT")
            check(re.search(r"^Encrypted:\s+no\b", text, re.MULTILINE) is not None, "PDF_ENCRYPTED")
            return {"status": "VALID_PDF", "total_pages": count}
        except (AnnouncementError, UnicodeError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
            return {
                "status": "PDF_PARSE_FAILED",
                "total_pages": None,
                "error": str(error)
                if isinstance(error, AnnouncementError)
                else type(error).__name__,
            }
